OMEN Entry Deck 200 days · entry + stop

0 / 200 done

How to mark a card

Long you would BUY here — you expect the price to go up.
Short you would SELL SHORT here — you expect the price to go down.
no trade nothing worth taking on this day. Skip it.
entry bar click the chart on the candle you would enter on. A yellow dashed line and a dot at its close appear.
stop price flip the toggle above the chart to stop price, then click the chart at the height your stop sits at. A red line is drawn and the risk band is shaded. You can also type the price in the box.
After you set the entry the toggle flips to stop price on its own, so it is click-entry, click-stop, next card. Everything saves as you go — closing the page does not lose marks.
